Grand Opening Oct. 17: Hayden Brook will celebrate its Grand Opening on Saturday, Oct. 17, from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m., featuring model tours, refreshments and a giveaway. Two-story floor plans: The Birch, Sapling and Hazel at Hayden Brook range from 2,987 to 3,829 square feet with 4 to 6 bedrooms, starting at $688,990. Room to grow and flexible living spaces: Every Hayden Brook floor plan includes a main-level bedroom, and select plans add a study, loft or gameroom. Future amenities: A pool, pavilion with restrooms, playground, and mail kiosk are planned for the community. articles.summary: Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek and U.S. News World Report's Best Companies to Work For—today announced it has acquired substantially all of the assets of HMH Lifestyles, L.P., doing business as HistoryMaker Homes. Founded in 1949 in Fort Worth and headquartered in Grapevine, HistoryMaker Homes is Texas' longest-standing production homebuilder and builds exclusively in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The acquisition significantly deepens Century Communities' position in the market, tripling its community count and meaningfully expanding the Company's lot pipeline. "HistoryMaker Homes gives us the scale, land position, and local talent to accelerate our growth in Dallas-Fort Worth, one of the largest housing markets in the country," said Rob Francescon, Chief Executive Officer of Century Communities. articles.title: Century Communities Triples Dallas-Fort Worth Footprint with Acquisition of HistoryMaker Homes
